epochs.method: Display only: per-epoch, full-field RGB medians on common six-detector coverage; joint symmetric 3-sigma clipping using 1.4826 MAD, up to 5 iterations. At least 16 pixels and 25% of the common coverage must remain. Offsets do not depend on pin, pan or zoom. This is not a source-masked sky model and can remove diffuse emission and background variability.
